title: StarChat mobile edition
description: Build time settings of a mobile app built from StarChat. See docs/mobile.md.

appName.description: Name under the launcher icon, in the store and in chat texts (:app).

appId.description: Android application id (package name). Never change it after the first release.

devAppId.description: Application id of the development build (build.mjs --dev), appId + ".dev" by default.

icon.description: Square PNG with at least 512x512 pixels, path relative to the edition folder. Launcher icon on Android 7, splash screen.

adaptiveIcon.description: Launcher icon from Android 8 on. Without it the icon is shown smaller on the background colour.

foreground.description: PNG (432x432 or more, transparent) or Android vector drawable (.xml). Keep the motif inside the middle 66 percent.

primaryServer.description: Domain of the network of your edition: the first connection goes there, login and features come from its discovery file. Leave it out for a client without a preset network.

networkName.description: Name of the primary network in the connections list (:network in texts). Defaults to primaryServer.

serverList.description: 'default', an https URL of an own list, or false for the primary server only.

themeCss.description: CSS file loaded after the bundled theme, relative to the edition folder.

startScript.description: JavaScript module run in the chat page before the chat starts, relative to the edition folder. Its default export is an async function. See docs/desktop.md.

modules.description: Names of the feature modules to ship. All bundled ones when left out.

texts.description: Texts that replace bundled ones, per language and key. Keys of the chat (src/i18n) and of the app (mobile/locales).

push.description: Push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging. Off when left out.

googleServices.description: google-services.json of your Firebase project, relative to the edition folder. Its package name must be appId. A google-services.json in the edition folder is used without this entry.

gateway.description: Base URL of a push gateway (starchat-irc/push-gateway) holding the service account of the same Firebase project. Used on networks with draft/webpush that do not relay to FCM themselves.
